# NEW 2026-11-18 round 3 N2 casus belli (oe_tcb_). Generated by gen_round3_cb.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope; yearly and once after loading. Opens the gate oe_tcb_open while a country other than BYZ holds a lost
# former province, and closes it when none is left.
oe_tcb_recount = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_country = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } any_owned_location = { oe_tcb_reclaimable = yes } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open } } set_variable = oe_tcb_open }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open }
        remove_variable = oe_tcb_open
    }
}

# BYZ scope. After a won reclaim war. var:oe_tcb_taken_n = former-province locations taken in the peace; countries
# that took part carry oe_tcb_in_war. Every other Orthodox country with antagonism towards BYZ: -1 per location
# (at most -8 and at most its present antagonism; fades by 3 a year). Notice oe_tcb.1 for a human Byzantium.
# Readings for the event: oe_tcb_last_n (locations), oe_tcb_last_r (relief), oe_tcb_last_c (countries).
oe_tcb_apply_relief = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tcb_byz
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_taken_n value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_last_n value = var:oe_tcb_taken_n }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_last_r value = var:oe_tcb_taken_n }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_tcb_last_r min = 0 max = 8 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_last_c value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 1 }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                NOT = { tag = BYZ }
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_in_war }
                antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 8 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 8 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 8 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 7 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 7 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 7 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 6 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 6 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 6 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 5 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 5 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 4 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 4 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 4 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 3 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 3 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 3 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tcb_byz = { has_variable = oe_tcb_last_r var:oe_tcb_last_r >= 2 } antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz value >= 2 } }
                add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 2 }
            }
            else = { add_antagonism = { target = scope:oe_tcb_byz modifier = oe_tcb_ortho_relief scale = 1 } }
            scope:oe_tcb_byz = { change_variable = { name = oe_tcb_last_c add = 1 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tcb } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tcb value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tcb add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcb.1 }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod / console, BYZ scope)
# Marks the 3 most populous locations of a random neighbour outside the bloc as lost former provinces, opens the gate
# and gives BYZ the casus belli on that country (the engine may also create it by itself while the gate is open).
oe_tcb_test_mark = {
    random_neighbor_country = {
        limit = { NOT = { oe_tcb_bloc = yes } country_type = location }
        save_scope_as = oe_tcb_test_t
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tcb_test_t }
        scope:oe_tcb_test_t = {
            ordered_owned_location = {
                order_by = population
                max = 3
                check_range_bounds = no
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = var:oe_theme_region }
                }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = 0 } }
                set_variable = oe_tw_former_lost
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open } } set_variable = oe_tcb_open }
        add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_tcb_test_t type = casus_belli:oe_tcb_reclaim }
    }
}
# Applies the Orthodox relief as if a reclaim war had just returned 3 locations (no war: every Orthodox country
# except BYZ counts as uninvolved), then shows oe_tcb.1.
oe_tcb_test_relief = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_taken_n value = 3 }
    oe_tcb_apply_relief = yes
}
